fields.description: Issue includes commentary and reporting on Dade County politics and a grand jury investigation, with emphasis on gambling operations in Miami Beach and allegations involving public officials. Coverage also includes horse racing at Hialeah (including discussion of a disputed race and track scrutiny), local nightlife and entertainment listings/advertising, and a feature marking President Franklin D. Roosevelt’s birthday with a list of supporters and organizations.
